verified_sound: Binds only to Tailscale utun 100.64/10 or RFC1918 addresses, TLS 1.3, no peer-to-peer, Bonjour on LAN only
Pairing: 128-bit code, 120 s, single use, 5 attempts, HMAC bound to transcript, challenge and device key; Mac identity pinned before proof
One stored phone; replacement needs Mac confirmation; X25519/HKDF/ChaChaPoly session with strict counters
Size caps: 8 MB frame, 256 KB chunk, 25 MB upload, 64 KB avatar, 5 MB attachment; no phone-supplied path reaches the filesystem
Executor idempotent by command id; replays and queries never run; results stored before sending; phone never resends
Phone saves a command before sending; a failed load surfaces as loadFailed, never an empty store
Merged pbxproj includes both Remote* and AgentControl* sources and tests
